title: Waiver Months on a Changed Plan — Benefit Overpayment Accounts Ledger Guide
content:
A substantial waiver on Benefit Overpayment Accounts earns waiver months, added to the changed-plan months when the installment of a current repayment plan is changed. The size of the waiver is measured by the principal waived on the overpayment as a share of the principal assessed.

| Principal waived as a share of the principal assessed | Waiver months added |
|---|---|
| At least 0.5 (the major-waiver share, 50 percent) | 3, the major-waiver extension |
| Above zero but below 0.5 | 1, the minor-waiver extension |
| No principal waived | None |

## Reading the ledger

- The principal waived is the total of the waiver adjustment entries on the overpayment's ledger.
- The principal assessed is the total of the principal assessment entries on the same ledger.

## Hypothetical cases

| Principal assessed | Principal waived | Share | Months added |
|---|---|---|---|
| USD 3,000.00 | USD 1,500.00 | 0.5 | 3 |
| USD 3,000.00 | USD 1,499.99 | just below 0.5 | 1 |
| USD 3,000.00 | Nothing | 0 | None |
